text:
maria: Kicking off account + VNet priming for ap-southeast-3 GPU pool. Target: 4x A100 nodes (dedicated project). Need quotas, KMS, TF state bucket, and basic network layout by EOD. Tagging @sasha for CIDR/KMS, @ajay for quotas/routing, @kevin for costs.

ajay: Ack. Quota request opened yesterday — cloud support says 48-72h. Request ID PRJ-48392-GPU. Will follow up with partner rep.

ajay: Also recommending separate service project for shared infra (logging, nat, tfstate) to keep prod project minimal.

sasha: On CIDR. I want to avoid collisions with existing partner ranges. Suggest 10.140.0.0/16 for region, allocate subnets: 10.140.0.0/24 (mgmt), 10.140.1.0/22 (gpu-pool-a), 10.140.5.0/22 (gpu-pool-b).

sasha: Running overlap check... result: OK. KMS regional support looks limited to symmetric keys; security needs to confirm rotation policy.

infra-bot: Preflight report: terraform state bucket found? NO. IAM roles: redwood-infra-admin present. VPC peering quota: 2/5 used. Firewall default rules detected. Missing: NAT gateway, TF locking bucket, regional KMS key.

maria: Draft preflight checklist (short):
- Cloud account / project created and billing enabled
- Billing export hooked to billing bucket
- Regional KMS key created (ap-southeast-3) with rotation policy
- VPC 10.140.0.0/16 created with subnets (mgmt, gpu-a, gpu-b)
- NAT gateway + route table for private gpu subnets
- Firewall rules: internal allow ssh 22, infra ports 9000-9100; egress 80/443 allowed
- Service accounts + least-priv IAM roles
- TF state bucket + locking enabled (regional)
- GPU quota request approved
- Cost tags (cost-center, env) added to resources

kevin: Quick cost note: rough baseline for 4x A100 fleet ~ $X/hr (compute only). Add storage, networking, and egress. I'll drop a spreadsheet but anticipate ~$Y/day initial burn. Recommend cost-alerts on project.

sasha: Security note: HSM not available in this region per docs; if customer requires HSM, we must flag as constraint. KMS alias planned: projects/../locations/asia-southeast3/keyRings/redwood/cryptoKeys/redwood-apse3-infra. Need security sign-off for rotation 90d.

ajay: For cluster provisioning: use dedicated subnet per nodepool, enable node auto-repair but hold autoscaling until quotas confirmed. Terraform modules already exist under infra/modules/gke-gpu; will reuse.

maria: Handoff plan to eng-sre once quotas + KMS green:
- Owner: eng-infra (maria) -> eng-sre ops during maintenance window
- Prepare PR with TF modules and variable file (CIDR, KMS, bucket)
- Run infra-bot preflight and address failures
- Apply in staging (dry-run) then prod PR during window
- Post-provision validation: ping nodes, run gpu smoke test (nvidia-smi), run 10-min throughput bench, verify TF state locked

ops-auto: Maintenance window scheduled: 2024-02-18 02:00 UTC. Notifying oncall.

kevin: Please enforce tags: cost-center=redwood-inference, env=prod-staging on every infra resource. I'll add tag enforcement into TF policy.

maria: Any blockers? @sasha?

sasha: Two blockers: 1) GPU quota pending (ajay tracking). 2) KMS approval from security — they requested a short risk doc about keys and rotation. I can draft.

ajay: If quota is delayed beyond provisioning window, fallback: launch smaller dev-capacity in existing region (sfo) for soft-launch and queue full region launch when quota approves.

maria: Good fallback. I'll keep this thread as the single source of truth for priming. Attaching quick commands for setup: 
```
gcloud projects create redwood-apse3-gpu --name="redwood-ap-southeast-3-gpu"
gcloud services enable compute.googleapis.com cloudkms.googleapis.com iam.googleapis.com
gsutil mb -l asia-southeast3 gs://redwood-apse3-tfstate
```

maria: Thanks all :thumbsup:
